core_changes: Pending plans are created from H1/M15/M5 without requiring current M1 trigger
BUY LIMIT / SELL LIMIT / BUY STOP / SELL STOP candidates are generated and ranked
Primary and Backup pending plans include entry, SL, TP1, TP2, RR, cancel and gap rules
Closed market supports LAST SESSION planning for up to 72 hours
Open stale market can show plan reference but requires data revalidation before arming
M1/M5 are optional revalidation monitors, not plan-creation blockers
GitHub outcome journal now tracks pending-plan fills and 15/30/60 minute results
Champion governance can auto-rollback on degraded pending-entry quality
Auto-rollback has same-run cooling-off so an unproven challenger cannot instantly replace restored model
